proposedOperatorData.name: Bala Adventure & Watersports Centre
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Family-run watersports and adventure activities on Llyn Tegid, Wales' largest natural lake
proposedOperatorData.description:
Bala Adventure & Watersports Centre is a family-run outdoor activity centre based on the foreshore of Llyn Tegid (Bala Lake), the largest natural lake in Wales, within the Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park. The centre offers tuition, courses, and equipment hire in canoeing/kayaking, stand up paddleboarding (including SUP yoga), sailing, windsurfing, and powerboating on the lake, alongside land-based activities such as climbing and abseiling, gorge walking, mountain biking, archery, camp craft, raft building, hill walking, and white water rafting arranged off-site. It is an RYA Training Centre and holds an Adventure Activities Licensing Authority (AALA) licence, running sessions for individuals, families, schools, and corporate groups.

Equipment (kayaks, canoes, SUP boards, sailing dinghies and windsurfers) can be hired by the hour directly from the lake foreshore, and a paying-machine permit from Snowdonia National Park (Eryri) is required separately for any independent watercraft use on the lake. Half-day and full-day taster courses are available, with a minimum age of 8 for kayaking/canoeing activities.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: One of the longest-established watersports operators directly on Bala Lake's foreshore, combining RYA-accredited sailing/watersports tuition with AALA-licensed land-based adventure activities under one family-run business.
